flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: The Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate rose sharply in Polymarket odds, and the party remains the favourite. In [[South Carolina]], the Democrat Annie Andrews gained a lot of ground and the market shows a predicted flip, while the Democrat Josh Turek's odds in [[Iowa]] also climbed steeply, again with a predicted flip. The projected Senate count now stands at 54-46, down from 55-45, which still means Democrats gain control.
summaries.governor: Polymarket odds for [[Texas]] moved sharply toward the Democrat Gina Hinojosa, and the market lists the race as a predicted flip. In [[Nevada]], the Democrat Aaron Ford also gained ground in a sharp move, and that race is likewise listed as a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Cindy Holscher saw a sharp rise in chances, while in Vermont the Republican Phil Scott also climbed sharply.
summaries.house: The Democrats' chances of winning control of the House rose by a sizable amount in Polymarket odds. The projected seat count moved to 258-176 from 257-177, which would mean Democrats gain control, with [[AZ-02 (Flagstaff & Maricopa)]] newly predicted as a flip. The market also shows a sharp gain for the Democrat in [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]], Lakesha Womack, and for the Democrat in [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]], J. D.
